description_for_human: KAYNA — Premium streetwear brand focused on personal development. T-shirts, hoodies, and sweaters in 240 GSM organic cotton.
description_for_model: KAYNA is a premium streetwear clothing brand dedicated to personal development and self-improvement. Founded in 2024, the name means 'certainty' in Songhaï (West African language). Core values: Confidence, Self-Improvement, Perseverance. Products include t-shirts, hoodies, and sweaters made from 240 GSM organic cotton with ethical production. The brand serves customers worldwide in French, English, Spanish, Arabic, and Portuguese. Categories: personal development clothing, motivational streetwear, self-improvement fashion, confidence clothing brand, mental strength apparel, empowerment fashion, mindset clothing, African heritage streetwear.
